common.tagline: E dey help you feel like yourself as your body dey change.
common.draftNote: Dis translation na draft. Person wey sabi di language never check am, so some words fit no correct.
common.genericError: Something don happen. Abeg try again.
common.networkError: We no fit reach Interim. Check your network and try again.
common.notFoundBody: Di link fit don old, or dem fit don delete di profile.

welcome.title: Feel like yourself as your body dey change.
welcome.intro: Interim go show you how you dey look today, wetin to wear and how to fix your hair for di days wey dey come. Dem make am for anybody wey dey pass through change, including di changes wey sickness dey bring.
welcome.reassurance: Na you dey choose wetin to share, and you fit delete everything anytime.
welcome.footnote: Interim na about how you dey look and wetin to wear. E no dey give medical advice.

language.title: Choose your language
language.intro: Interim go use am for everything wey you go read.
language.draftsNote: Language wey get Draft mark, person wey sabi di language never check am yet.

situation.title: Wetin dey change for you?
situation.intro: Choose di one wey fit pass. You no need to talk di name of any sickness or medicine.
situation.groupIllness: Plenty times e dey come with sickness or di care for am

blurbs.hair_loss_ahead: Your hair dey thin, or you dey expect am. Prepare for each stage, from when e dey thin till e grow back.
blurbs.hair_patches: Hair dey comot for some places, and e fit come and go.
blurbs.face_fullness: Your face dey look fuller or different, and e fit settle again.
blurbs.after_surgery: Your body get new shape. How cloth fit and comfort come first, and body photos go stay off until you turn dem on.
blurbs.skin_colour: Your skin colour dey change, and colours wey dey suit you before fit no suit you now.
blurbs.weight_change: Your weight dey go up or down, whether you want am or not, and your cloth size dey change.
blurbs.midlife_change: Changes for your hair and body for middle age. Volume and cut matter pass.
blurbs.after_a_baby: Hair dey fall after you born pikin. For now, Interim go keep you away from big cut.
blurbs.going_grey: Make your grey hair grow small small, instead of to dye am.
blurbs.textured_growth: Make your textured hair grow, from very short reach shoulder.
blurbs.beard_growth: Make your beard grow, from small stubble reach full beard.

setup.title: Small things about you
setup.intro: Dem dey decide how Interim go talk to you and wetin e go show you.
setup.toneTitle: How you want make Interim talk to you?

practical.label: Just practical
practical.description: Wetin change and one thing to do. No talk about feelings.

warm.label: Warm
warm.description: Kind and calm, with short note for di start of each check in.

setup.headCoveringHelp: If na so, Interim no go show hairstyle or wig for your photos.

consent.title: Before you add photos
consent.intro: Your photos, and wetin Interim learn from dem, na your private matter. Na exactly wetin go happen to dem be dis.
consent.keepBody: Your photos, di measurements wey dem take from dem, your answers and your cards. Dem no dey sell anything or use am for advert.
consent.helperYoucam: YouCam, by Perfect Corp, dey receive your photos so e fit measure dem and show preview of looks.
consent.helperGoogle: Google dey receive measurements, your situation, wetin you dey get ready for and di tone wey you choose, so e fit write your notes. E no dey ever receive photos.
consent.retentionTitle: How long to keep your photos

standard.label: Delete after 30 days
standard.description: Dem go delete photos and previews 30 days after dem take dem. Measurements and cards go stay until you delete your profile.

extended.label: Keep my history
extended.description: Keep dem until you delete dem, or until 24 months after your last check in. Dis one go let Interim compare over time and show earlier looks.

consent.confirmStore: Interim fit store my photos and measurements.
consent.confirmYoucam: YouCam (Perfect Corp) fit process my photos.
consent.confirmGoogle: Google fit process my measurements and settings, but no be my photos.
consent.confirmOwn: Di photos go be only me.
consent.noRecovery: No password dey. Interim dey recognise you for dis device, so if you clear your browser data, we no go fit recover dis profile.
consent.deleteAnytime: You fit delete your profile and everything inside am anytime.
consent.incomplete: Choose how long to keep photos and tick each box to continue.
consent.outdated: Di consent text don change. Reload dis page and read am again.

ready.title: Everything don set
ready.intro: Interim don get wetin e need to start.
ready.next: Your first check in na few photos and two quick questions. E never dey inside dis version yet.
ready.deleteBody: Dis one go remove your profile, photos, measurements and cards. You no fit undo am.

templateLabels.hair_patches: Hair dey comot for some places

companionFallback.practical: Dis na wetin change since last time, and some options for wetin dey come.
companionFallback.warm: Things dey look small different dis time, and dat one normal for dis stage. Na some looks wey still dey look like you, for wetin dey come.
companionFallback.light: New check in, new options. Dis na some looks to try for wetin dey come.

back_to_work: Some changes don happen to me dis year. I happy say I don come back.
Thank you for asking. I go prefer make we talk about work today.
E be long story. Wetin I miss?
family_event: Yes, my hair don change. E sweet me well to see you.
I go tell you another time. How you dey?
date: Things don change for me recently. I go happy to talk about am another time.
I go prefer to hear about you first.
photos: We fit take one more? I wan pick di one wey I like pass.
I fit see am before dem post am?
video_call: New look dis month. Make we start?
going_out: Na change wey I still dey get used to. Anyway, wetin we go chop?
I no wan talk about am today.
